literal: Millet-measure good-deed even-if-done, palmyra-measure-as they-will-consider value those-who-know.
translation: Even if a good deed is as tiny as a millet seed, those who know its true value will consider it as large as a palmyra tree.
modern: ஒருவர் தினையளவு சிறிய உதவியைச் செய்தாலும், அந்த உதவியின் உண்மையான பயனை அறிந்தவர்கள் அதனைப் பனையளவு பெரியதாகக் கருதுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the tiny millet seed with the massive palmyra tree to illustrate how gratitude is measured. Even if a good deed is objectively small, its worth is not judged merely by its physical size. Those who truly understand the value of the help received will magnify it in their hearts, seeing it as vast as a palmyra tree.
